intro: Government and technology sectors bore the brunt of the 19 incidents tagged CISA between April and August 2026, with most activity centered on the United States and Global regions. Fifteen high-severity and three critical cases were documented, involving threat actors GRU, Interlock, and Lazarus Group as separate entities. Key vulnerabilities included CVE-2024-57726 (CVSS 9.9), CVE-2026-21643 (CVSS 9.1), and CVE-2026-34197 (CVSS 8.8), alongside CVE-2024-1708 and CVE-2026-68820. Affected sectors also spanned defense, aerospace, and critical infrastructure, with reports covering North America, Brazil, and Europe.
